operational_question: When did trustworthy evidence justify investigation?
evidence_to_stop_clock: Advisory or telemetry or validated report with provenance and UTC timestamp

operational_question: Which services and running versions are in scope?
evidence_to_stop_clock: Build inventory joined to service owners and network exposure

operational_question: Is an approved fix available for this environment?
evidence_to_stop_clock: Package advisory and build identifier and artifact provenance and change approval

operational_question: Have affected live instances been upgraded or replaced?
evidence_to_stop_clock: Deploy record and runtime fingerprint and restart or image-replacement record

operational_question: Is every in-scope asset fixed or specifically excepted?
evidence_to_stop_clock: Version checks and targeted tests and reconciliation with inventory

operational_question: Was activity assessed back to the earliest credible observation?
evidence_to_stop_clock: Defined log lookback and investigation notes and decisions and known visibility gaps
